comment: Upstream provenance for every OpenChamber patch in the queue. `relationship` says what an upstream release would mean for this patch: same (we shipped this change, or upstream did), alternative (upstream shipped a different design for the same need, so the patch needs reconciling rather than porting), partial (upstream took part of it), pending (a PR or issue is open and nothing has shipped), none (local only, no upstream counterpart). `mergedAs` is the merge commit when one exists. `intent` says what the patch deserves upstream: bugfix (a broken thing upstream owns), feature, personal (stays local), testing (wants more use before deciding) or declined (the maintainer refused it). `since` is the date this record was last checked. Update this file whenever a patch is added, dropped or re-expressed; scripts/openchamber-upstream.sh fails when a queued patch has no record here.

codex-credits-balance.note: Merged 2026-11-15, after the v2.7.2 tag, so it leaves the queue when a release contains it.

question-indicator.note: Feature awaiting acceptance; builds only on top of stale-pending-badge.

stale-pending-badge.note: Behaviour only. Draft PR #6804; posts on Jeremy's word.

reply-start-scroll.note: Feature request open; branch matches the patch.

dictation-thread-count.note: Merged as the cgroup-aware version, which the patch already carries.

draft-heading-project-picker.note: Local only; no upstream request yet.

recap-full-note.note: A UI preference: the recap keeps its whole note. Stays local.

image-viewer-zoom.note: Local only; no upstream request yet. Also carries the shared `ImageZoomControls` cluster and the files preview edit, so both viewers read and step one zoom bar.

mobile-assist-trigger.note: Registers the power-button assistant role for dictation. Wants a few more days of use first.

mobile-voice-launch.note: Android deep link into dictation. Wants a few more days of use first.

dictation-recovery.note: The dictate deep-link origin half has a bug report open.

instance-attention.note: Local only; cross-instance attention across saved instances and the app's own server.

question-rows.note: Question turns as timeline rows. Still under test.

question-cards.note: The question card and sticky header. Still under test; carries the wording.

in-work-paging.note: Attention ranking for the In work section. A maintainer rejection is recalled but not found in the tracker, so unconfirmed.

hide-empty-worktrees.note: Worktree rows with nothing in them leave the lists.

gitea-references-across.note: PR closed unmerged; upstream still gates referencesAcross off for Gitea. Branch held so the PR can reopen.

send-past-open-question.note: Sending while a question is open kills the ask. Reproduced on 2.7.2; queue-holds-pending-question is the release half.

android-notification-dismiss.note: Draft PR holding the local banner clear that upstream's push-based clearing does not cover.

notification-family-clear.note: The family clear the server never had: a subagent's banner never clears because upstream walks no parents. Branch built, report pending; the wiring that dropped the view options is fixed in the queue.

chat-width-remap.note: Upstream shipped Default/Wider/Full in v2.7.2; this maps the older local levels onto it. Reconcile rather than port when the ladder changes again.

chat-width-80.note: The extra 80rem level on top of upstream's ladder, with the composer matched. Local addition pending its own upstream request.

in-work-paging-show-more.note: Restored after the 2.7.2 port dropped it; depends on in-work-paging.

mobile-guest-catalog-failure.note: A failed catalog read on the phone reads as no extensions. Reproduced on v2.7.2 with a corrupt extensions.json; branch built, report pending.

changed-file-chip-opens-file-outside-git.note: A changed-file chip whose file no repository lists opens the file, instead of leaving an empty Changed list. Draft PR; posts when it is ready.

question-interrupt-state.note: Upstream's classifyQuestionToolError treats any error type other than aborted as a dismissal, an interrupt stores unknown, and deriveRecoveredQuestions skips anything that is not turn-death, so an interrupted question is dropped instead of offered for recovery. Branch built, report pending.

question-recorded-answers.note: Rides with the question-rows/question-cards stack rather than a separate request; upstream now has a PR for the quote case (an expanded row cutting an answer at its first double quote). questionEntries.ts is ours, not upstream's.

queue-holds-pending-question.note: Release half of the pending-question send: the queue holds a session while a question or page form waits, then releases on settle. Pairs with send-past-open-question, which covers the composer path.

candidates.name: chat-small-image-upscale
candidates.note: The chat's tool-output dialog draws a picture larger than its own pixels at fit: a 64x64 icon renders near 1055%, where the files preview never upscales. No local patch yet.
